reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's B3 'per-platform tuned ladder' (steering offset + understeer K + -3-sample lag) using per-platform parameters read from out/results.json; predict equation (v/L)*tan(delta - delta_off)/(1 + K*v^2) then per-segment lag shift.
notes: Used canonical filter v_mps>2.0 (agent fit on v_mps>1.0 with |a_lat|<20 filter); applied per-platform params (Mach-E: K=2.9e-4 d_off=0; F-150: K=1.3e-3 d_off=0.0005 rad) and -3-sample lag shift per segment; baseline_recomputed matches cached canonical V0 to numerical precision.
